AirCalibration.Name: Air Calibration
AirCalibration.Message: if there are deposits on the measurement window that are difficult to remove, the measurement area can be soaked in pyxis probe cleaning solution for 10-15 minutes, then rinsed with clean water and wiped dry with a soft cloth to remove any residual liquid. finally, the measurement window can be shaded for air calibration.
